title: Exceptional lessons start with connection
description: Opening brand lockup for the funding pitch.
speakerNotes: Open on the CCD mark. Calm and confident. Line: Exceptional lessons start with connection. Pause. Let the brand land before the case.

title: Arts teachers are working alone
description: The funding problem — fragmented practice and invisible arcs.
speakerNotes: Arts teachers — drama, dance, music — are still stitching years from PDFs, drives and last year's tabs. Often the only specialist in the building. Great practice gets lost. This is the gap funding must close.

title: A connection layer for the arts
description: Why CCD: hubs, national partners, classroom craft.
speakerNotes: CCDesigner is the connection layer. Music Hubs. National and regional arts partners. Classroom craft. One workspace so sector expertise reaches the teacher who needs it on Tuesday morning.

title: Music hubs in Partner Hubs
description: EMS, Tri-Borough, LSO — regional and national music in one home.
speakerNotes: Partner Hubs puts Music Hubs and organisations in one place. Essex Music Service. Tri-Borough. LSO. Regional delivery and national excellence — side by side.

title: From hub to library
description: LSO Add to CCDesigner — trusted content into the teacher's library.
speakerNotes: Open a hub. Choose a resource. Add to CCDesigner. Sector content lands inside the teacher's living library — not a dead download on a desktop.

title: Jazz North — Add to CCDesigner
description: Organisation hub example: Mr Big, Playlist Project, worksheet packs.
speakerNotes: Same moment for organisations. Jazz North — Mr Big, Playlist Project, free worksheet packs. Open the hub, Add to CCDesigner, and sector practice seeds into Year 2 Music and beyond.

title: Partner packs and personal resources
description: Add from hubs and create personal resources.
speakerNotes: Teachers also bring their own materials. Partner packs and personal resources sit together — sector-backed and school-owned.

title: Create an activity — tagged to years
description: Activity creator with year-group tagging and resource links.
speakerNotes: Create an activity. Name it. Attach video, backing track, worksheet. Tag the year groups that teach it — Year 2 Music, KS1, Assembly — so it appears where planning happens.

title: Name your year groups
description: Settings year groups named to match the school.
speakerNotes: Every school names its own years. Lower Kindergarten Music. Year 6 Music. Settings fit the school — so activities and lessons attach to real class names, not a generic list.

title: Starter, main, plenary — one hour
speakerNotes: Then build the lesson. Starter. Main. Plenary. Drag example activities into place. Cap: sixty minutes. One hour. Real timetable. Teachable craft for a real day.

title: Lessons become a whole unit
description: Scheme of work / half-term unit on the planner.
speakerNotes: Lessons stack into a whole unit. Assign to a half-term. See the arc across six weeks — visible as a journey, not a pile of files.

title: Calendar and key dates
description: Week view with lessons and partner key dates.
speakerNotes: The calendar holds it. Lessons on the week. Partner key dates — concerts, workshops, inset — on the same grid. The living timetable where hubs and schools meet.

title: PDFs with live links — and share planning
description: Print PDFs with clickable resource links; share planning links.
speakerNotes: Print the PDF. The links stay live — video, audio, worksheets still clickable in the classroom. Share planning with a colleague in one link. Cover staff get the craft, not a scavenger hunt.

title: Hub backend and reach — hashed IPs
description: Organisation hub admin, download tracking, privacy-preserving analytics.
speakerNotes: Behind the hubs: organisation backend. Partners publish and change resources. Download tracking shows reach. IPs are hashed — impact evidence for hubs and funders, without exposing teachers.

title: Celebrating learning in the arts
description: Surfacing craft for parents, leaders and the sector.
speakerNotes: This is how we celebrate learning in the arts — daily craft made visible to parents, leaders, hubs and the wider sector.

title: Fund the connection layer
speakerNotes: The ask: fund the connection layer between hubs and classrooms. Visit ccdesigner.co.uk. Contact rob at rhythmstix.co.uk. Book a thirty-minute funder walkthrough. End clean.
